description: How agentgrid (Lattice) improves itself. Level by the fleet walkthrough: L2. L1, the evals (eval/run.sh) gate every push and pull request in CI (.github/workflows/test.yml). L2, a nightly loop (.github/workflows/improve.yml running scripts/improve.mjs) runs the evals, measures the live CLI and MCP surface against the docs, skills and memory, and writes a proposal. It never merges by itself: a person reviews and merges every change. Not L3: the loop does not yet change its own checks.

eval.rubric: eval/run.sh: L1 eval/smoke.sh and eval/surfaces.py, L2 eval/golden.sh (golden tasks on a private tmux server, pass^3)
eval.gate: every eval passes && no test fails && golden time within 1.5x of eval/baseline.json
